1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; __the processor__ accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and __the processor__ making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: __the processor automatically retrieving and analyzing biometric authentication data from the data store to verify the recipient's identity through a technical mechanism that requires specialized computer hardware and software to access, process, and validate the biometric authentication records__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a __predetermined__ period of time prior to said accessing step.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said predetermined period of time is seven days.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said predetermined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; __the processor__ comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a predetermined permissive time interval; __the processor__ making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the predetermined permissive time interval; and __the processor__ requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the predetermined permissive time interval, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: __the processor automatically retrieving, analyzing, and comparing biometric authentication timestamps from the data store using a technical mechanism that requires specialized computer hardware and software to access, process, validate, and time-correlate the biometric authentication records to determine payment eligibility__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the predetermined permissive time interval is seven days.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the predetermined permissive time interval is 24 hours.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the processor is further operative to perform at least one additional technological function beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: automatically retrieving and analyzing biometric authentication data from the data store to verify the recipient's identity through a technical mechanism that requires specialized computer hardware and software to access, process, and validate the biometric authentication records__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a __predetermined__ period of time prior to said accessing.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said predetermined period of time is seven days.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said predetermined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction.
